text.en: Gordon Tannen, born in Columbia, was promoted to Chief Inspector of the Columbian Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units, and Originium following the Propeller Paradise Incident. He has also been restored to his position as Chief Executive of Propeller Paradise. He has entered into cooperation with Rhodes Island to secure legitimate channels for our Oripathy medicine to enter the Columbian market, while also representing Propeller Paradise in our joint aerospace research.
text.zh: 高登·谭农，哥伦比亚人，在“螺旋桨天堂”事件后，升任哥伦比亚烟酒施术单元以及源石制品管理局探员总管，并恢复“螺旋桨天堂”总长官身份。现与罗德岛达成合作，既以管理局的名义帮助罗德岛打通矿石病药物进入哥伦比亚市场的合法渠道，也以“螺旋桨天堂”的名义与罗德岛共同进行天空相关的科研。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Skybox shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Skybox regularly comes into contact with Originium products, resulting in heightened risk of infection.

Hope that suit of his doesn't start leaking Originium. He doesn't take it off even when he sleeps...
—Space Fin 054
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员天空盒没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员天空盒频繁接触各类源石制品，面临着较大的感染风险。

但愿他睡觉都不肯脱的那身行头别有哪个部件的源石成分突然漏了……
——太空鳞兽零五四

text.en:
[Excerpt from the Propeller Paradise Administration Rules for Secretaries]
......
04. Anticipate the boss's needs and serve tea at the right time by listening to the boss's voice and observing the scales around his mouth.
22. Respect your boss!! Stop bringing tea whenever you think he's thirsty. You're his secretary, not his mom! Stop treating him like a kid!
......
09. Do not interrupt the boss, argue with the boss, or steal the boss's words in front of other people. Actually, just shut your mouth, there's no need for you to talk.
15. Immediately remind the boss if he makes a mistake during a negotiation. If you don't, it's your fault if anything goes wrong.
......
12. Know your boss, and communicate his intentions with absolute faithfulness when negotiating, for you are his personal representative.
17. Use your brain when negotiating, don't just communicate his intentions. No one will take you seriously if they can tell you're just repeating what your boss said.
......

'Did you really spend six months under Mr. Tannen as his secretary, Mercia? Is it really possible to follow all these rules at the same time?'
'Yes. It just takes more effort. But there is also a way to make him forget all these rules and work with you in a different way.'
'Really?'
'Pay close attention to his outfit, his little robot, and all the Originium equipment and Arts units he fiddles with. Express as much interest as you can feign.'
'...And then?'
'And then, you just deal with him like you would deal with the most talkative boy in class when you were in elementary school.'
—Conversation between Mercia, former secretary to the Chief Executive of Propeller Paradise, and her successor
text.zh:
【“螺旋桨天堂”行政部秘书准则摘录】
……
04.能主动发现上司的各类需求，能根据说话的声音和嘴上鳞片的透明度分辨上司是否口渴，是否应该倒茶。
22.尊重上司！！！别一看上司口渴了就擅自端茶送水的，你是来当秘书的不是当妈，别把上司当小孩伺候。
……
09.在外人面前，任何情况下不得打断上司、反驳上司、抢上司的话。或者说干脆把嘴闭紧就行，没你的事。
15.上司谈判时，如发现上司出现口误，应立刻提醒，以免酿成大错。要是真出了事，那就是你的问题。
……
12.对你的上司要足够熟悉，谈判时必须一字不差地复述他的言论。在外，你就是上司的绝对代言人。
17.谈判时带点脑子，不要只会照本宣科。如果谁都听得出你是在复读上司的原话，那谁都不会看得起你。
……

“梅希亚前辈……您真的给高登长官当了半年的秘书？这些准则，真的有办法同时履行吗？”
“可以，只是要多费点力气。不过，如果不想这么麻烦，也有办法让高登长官忘记这些条条框框，用另一种方式和你相处。”
“还能这样？”
“请好好关注他的那身行头，他身边的小机器人，和他捣鼓的所有源石制品以及施术单元，对它们表现出你能表现出的最大程度的兴趣。”
“……然后呢？”
“然后你只需要拿出小学的时候应付班上话最多的那个男生的经验，就好了。”
——谈话记录：“螺旋桨天堂”行政部前秘书梅希亚与前来请教经验的新任秘书

text.en: [Interview from the documentary Bluebeard and the Great Toothpaste Prohibition] When we talked about 'toothpaste tubes', we were talking about vehicle coolant pipes. When the Great Toothpaste Prohibition was first enacted, we filled the tubes with toothpaste and smuggled it from Kazimierz into Columbia. No one would find out unless you took the vehicle apart. You could only fool the ATAO for so long, though. Within six months, every checkpoint on the Columbian border had trained casters posted, and all it took was a wave of their wand to expose the goods. It was around that time that the name 'Bluebeard' started making its rounds. He was a mysterious figure who never showed his face, but it didn't matter. No one ever saw Mr. Max during the Revolutionary War, either. What mattered was that Bluebeard could help us avoid the checks. From anti-Arts coating to invisible tubes... he always had a way. Everybody knew the toothpaste hero who defied the authorities. They were singing songs about him: 'You can have my smokes and you can have my booze, but you can't have Bluebeard's toothpaste tube.' And you'd hear people boasting about brushing teeth with Bluebeard every night. What happened next? Heh, he sold us out and went into the ATAO. Some said he got bought out, other said he was coerced, but all we know is that we never heard from our toothpaste hero Bluebeard again. —A truck driver who worked as a smuggler during the Great Toothpaste Prohibition Gordon unabashedly describes his job at the ATAO as 'racing natives, refugees, and smugglers at the border checkpoints.' Border checkpoints are high-speed mobile platforms owned by the ATAO. They are little more than the size of a truck, but their speed is real, and smugglers call them 'toilets running with sirens blaring'. Gordon's primary responsibility at the ATAO was overseeing one such checkpoint, by himself all year round, chasing natives, refugees, and smugglers that crossed the border, and either negotiating with or fighting them until he retrieved the Originium hallucinogens from their false teeth, or the live Originium slugs from their tails. His biggest achievement over the years was confiscating a crown with a hundred thirty-two foldartals pasted on it, owned by a Sami snowpriest. Three years passed before Gordon returned from the border checkpoints to the nomadic cities. At Tkaronto port, he was stopped by an excited young reporter who wanted to know if he was the outlaw hero Bluebeard. As Gordon got away from the reporter, he said: 'Sure, people were putting 'Originium' on everything they could think of, and you could say that the president guided Originium fever in the direction he wanted. But why did it have to be toothpaste? 'Took me three years to figure it out. Someone had the bright idea to corner the dental hygiene market with Originium floss, so he called on every favor he could to get this crazy prohibition through Congress. Buying and selling toothpaste was banned the next day. 'That's how the rules of ATAO came about. The rules that some people bleed to protect, and others bleed to defy. How does fighting them make you any kind of hero?'
text.zh:
【纪录片《“蓝胡子”与牙膏大禁令》访谈片段】
那时候我们说“牙膏管子”，指的是车子的冷却液管。牙膏大禁令刚颁布的时候，我们就在管子里填满牙膏，从卡西米尔运进哥伦比亚。只要不把车拆了，就没人能发现。
但那毕竟是管理局。才半年，哥伦比亚每座边境哨所就都守着训练有素的术师了，他们拿法杖一扫，我们就露馅。
“蓝胡子”的名号就是在那时候传开的。神秘得很，从不露面，但有啥关系呢？独立战争的时候，不也没人见过麦克斯先生吗？重要的是，“蓝胡子”能帮我们躲过检查。什么反法术涂层，什么隐形塑料管……他总有办法。
反抗规则的牙膏英雄，人人都知道。人们游行的时候都在唱“管天管地，管理局管不了‘蓝胡子’的牙膏管子”，在夜店里，每天都有人吹嘘自己和“蓝胡子”“一起刷了牙”……
后来？呵。后来他背叛了我们，进了管理局。
有人说他是被收买了、被威胁了，也有人说他是去当卧底了。我只知道，我们的牙膏英雄“蓝胡子”，再没了音讯。
——牙膏大禁令期间从事走私活动的一名货车司机

提及自己在管理局的工作经历，高登毫不避讳地将之总结为“在边境哨所跟土著、难民和走私犯赛跑”。
所谓“边境哨所”，指的是管理局特有的高速移动平台。虽然被戏谑地称作“移动平台”，但它实际并不比运载车大。不过，“高速”的部分确实名副其实，走私犯们通常带着怨念将之描述为“一个闪着警灯狂奔的厕所”。
一个人，全年无休地驻守一座这样的哨所——这就是高登在管理局的主要职责。在荒原上追逐擅闯边境的土著、难民和走私犯，跟他们谈判或是搏斗，最后从他们的假牙里抠出源石致幻剂，或从尾巴里抠出活体源石虫，构成了高登几乎全部的工作经历。几年来，他最大的功绩，是没收了一位萨米雪祀贴满了一百三十二块密文板的头冠。
加入管理局三年后，高登才第一次从边境哨所回到移动城市。在提卡伦多港，一位年轻记者拦住了他，激动地询问他是否就是当年那位反抗规则的英雄“蓝胡子”。在甩开那位记者之前，高登留下了这样一段话：
“当然可以说那是因为大总统想把那股不管不顾给什么东西都加上源石的热潮导向他想要的方向，但为什么，偏偏，是牙膏？
“我花了三年才搞明白。就只是某个大老板一拍脑袋，想用什么‘源石牙线’占领牙膏市场。他费尽人脉，把一纸异想天开的禁令推进了议会。第二天，买卖牙膏就是犯法了。
“管理局的‘规则’，一些人拼了命维护，另一些人拼了命违抗的‘规则’，就是这么来的。跟它对着干，又算他妈什么‘英雄’了？”

text.en:
I thought it was a thief when someone knocked on the door late at night, but it was a strangely dressed Savra who called himself Gordon Tannen. I remembered that my father had kept cursing that name the last time he came home, as though he were his actual son.
Gordon seemed very interested in everything in my house. The warped floorboards, the leaky roof, mom's red and swollen eyes, and my Gaulish accent that I could never fix. That, and my name: Gustave Baune. When Dad left, it was like he took Mom's soul with him. She missed him so much she changed my name to be the same as his, but I could never become him. He was the head of the ATAO, while I was a loser who was good for nothing but cleaning people's cars. When she begged him to give me a job at the ATAO, he slapped her.
Dad left because we weren't good enough for him. That, I accepted, but I didn't need pity from someone who WAS good enough for him... This Gordon, looking down at us from on high.
Thankfully, he didn't say much. Indeed, he didn't say anything at all for ten minutes, as we sat around a table silently, to the sound of Mom crying. He finally opened his mouth right when I was about to see him out.
'You won't be seeing your dad again. Treason. Life sentence.'
I already knew. The courts had sent a letter.
'You're allowed to change your name under Columbian law. Come find me if you want to change it back, or to something else.'
What he gave me was not a business card, but a bottle opener with a propeller on it, and the words 'Propeller Paradise' displayed prominently.
—Marlin Baune (formerly Gustave Baune), son of Gustave, former head of ATAO, in an interview with Maylander

'Gordon Tannen. You deny any private dealings with the traitor Gustave, but you have met with his son, Marlin Baune, multiple times following his incarceration, even inviting him to a tour of Propeller Paradise, where you were sighted drinking and partying with him. What is your explanation?'
'I was Gustave's former subordinate, and he was Gustave's son, so me visiting him means that I had dealings with Gustave—is that what you're implying?'
'Maylander cannot eliminate the possibility.'
'Wow, it's that easy working at Maylander? Okay, I'm reporting that pineapple pizza is evidence of a conspiracy between Siesta and Siracusa. When do I get my paycheck from you guys?'
'......'
'Listen, man. That kid Marlin cleaned cars for people in that border town for a decade. He's even smoother dealing with foreigners than I am. The only reason he's still cleaning cars is because old Gustave saw him as a disgrace. And what's worse, made the kid believe it himself. Let me tell you what I'm gonna do with him. I'm gonna open a bottle of champagne with him, and then I'm gonna get him a job at ATAO working at the city checkpoint, where he's gonna shine like he's never shined before. That's how ATAO's gonna be from now on. No freaking glory and no freaking shame. You got the chops, you got the job.'
—Interview with Gordon Tannen by Maylander investigators
text.zh:
三更半夜有人敲门，我还以为是贼，但门口是个穿着怪异的萨弗拉，自称高登·谭农。我认得这名字，我爸最后一次回家的时候，整晚都在骂一个叫这名字的人，好像那才是他的亲生儿子。
那个高登看起来对我家的一切都很感兴趣，起翘的地板、漏水的天花板、我妈那没消过肿的眼、我那改不掉的高卢口音。当然，还有我的名字——古斯塔夫·博内。爸离家之后，我妈失了魂似的惦念他，把我的名字都改成了和他一样的。但我永远变不成我爸，他能在那什么管理局当局长，我就是个只会给人擦擦车的废物。我妈当初求他带我进管理局，他只是给了我妈一巴掌。
我爸是看不上我们才离了家，这我认，但我不需要他看得上的某个人……那个高登，高高在上地来怜悯我们。
好在，那个高登不怎么说话。三个人坐在桌边，就只有妈在哭。那样过了大概有十分钟，我实在忍不住要送他出去的时候，他才开了口。
“你不会再见到你爸了。叛国罪，终身监禁。”
法院来过信，我早就知道了。
“还有，哥伦比亚法律允许二次改名。如果你想把名字改回去，或者改成随便什么别的，找我。”
他没给我名片，而是掏出一个带螺旋桨的酒瓶起子，上面张扬地刻着“螺旋桨天堂”的字样。
——管理局前局长古斯塔夫的独生子，马林·博内（曾用名古斯塔夫·博内），接受梅兰德调查时的笔录

“高登·谭农。你否认与叛国犯古斯塔夫有任何形式的私下交易，但在古斯塔夫入狱后，你多次与他的独生子马林·博内私下会面。你甚至邀请马林参观了‘螺旋桨天堂’，并被目击与他一同……饮酒作乐。我们需要一个解释。”
“我是古斯塔夫曾经的下属，他是古斯塔夫的儿子，所以我去见他，就代表我和古斯塔夫有交易——是这意思？”
“梅兰德不排除这种可能性。”
“梅兰德的工作这么好干？那我现在断言菠萝披萨是汐斯塔和叙拉古勾结的罪证，梅兰德能不能给我发工资啊？”
“……”
“听好了。马林那小子在边境小镇上给人擦了十几年的车，他应付外国人比我都利索。他还在擦车的唯一原因，是古斯塔夫那个老东西一辈子都把他视作耻辱，而他自己也当真了。我接下来不仅要跟他开香槟庆祝，还要给他在管理局安排工作，让他在移动城市的关口大展拳脚。管理局以后就会是这样的地方，没有他妈的光荣也没有他妈的耻辱，谁有本事，谁上。”
——谈话记录：高登·谭农与梅兰德调查员

text.en: Welcome to the Sky Conqueror solo exhibition. I am your guide, Space Fin 054. The tour is about to begin. Please turn off your mobile terminals. The first exhibit is a video disc set of the classic 70s drama, Sandwalker. Sandwalker, which depicts the exploits of a free-spirited Kuranta warrior, instilled a certain idea of freedom in an entire generation. Students often skipped class to play 'Sandwalker' on school grounds. Young Gordon did not join the other children's games after watching Sandwalker. But one afternoon, several trucks from a nearby construction site drove onto the school grounds, and turned it into a sea of sand in front of the stunned security guards. Nobody knows how Gordon fooled the foreman and security, but everyone remembers how he put on a cardboard helmet and raised his arm triumphantly before charging into the sea of sand. The schoolchildren had two hours of unprecedented fun before Gordon was dragged into the principal's office. Gordon said, 'If you're already skipping class, why settle for standing on the playground spouting lines from the show?' ...... Exhibit 13 is a game disc released in 1082 by Blue Box Co., Columbia. Gordon's approach to gaming is unusual. While this game is not considered particularly difficult, he played through each stage multiple times until he reached the inventory limit for all equipment and items, before challenging the final boss. The plan was to use this wealth of items to overcome the boss with ease. However, game discs at the time had a short lifespan, and it broke down when Gordon reached the final stage, so he never managed to beat the game. Gordon said, 'What's the point of reaching the boss if I don't crush him the first time?' ...... Finally, we have here a shrub from Sargon. Originally a tiny bud picked from a wooden stick, it has now entered its fifth generation under the nurturing of Gordon's 'Growth-Encouraging Loudspeaker' and 'Nutrition Lightbulb'. Today, every street tree in Propeller Paradise is a descendant of the original bud. Another 100 saplings have been sent to Rhine Lab, in the hopes that this tree that survived the harsh environment of the foehn hotlands can become the first plant to grow outside the Starpod. The item previously belonged to an explorer Gordon described as 'a hateful free spirit'. He apparently declined an invitation from the explorer to travel together, not because he was uninterested in going where no one had gone before, but because he saw no point in unburdened exploration. Gordon said, 'That budding stick would be nothing but a stylish walking stick in your hands. Give it to me, and I'll show you a moving forest the next time you see it.' ...... 'Excellent, Five-Four. Absolutely perfect. You finally understand my needs.' 'When will this exhibition be held, Sky Conqueror?' 'There's no rush. When I pry all of Columbia off the face of Terra and conquer the skies with everyone with super propellers.... that'll be the day. For now, your mission is to recite those descriptions to me every night before bedtime.'
text.zh:
欢迎各位光临此次“‘天空征服者’个人展会”，我是本次展会的讲解员，太空鳞兽零五四。请各位关闭移动终端，游览马上开始。

第一件展品是70年代经典连续剧《沙行客》的影碟套组。
《沙行客》描绘了一位潇洒不羁的库兰塔战士。可以说，是这部作品将“自由”种进了一代青少年的内心。当时，学生三五成群地逃课，在操场上玩“扮演沙行客”的游戏，在哥伦比亚的中小学是极为常见的景象。
看过《沙行客》后，年少的高登并没有加入其他孩子的扮演游戏。但在某个寻常的下午，隔壁工地的几辆卡车招摇地开进学校，在保安惊诧的目光中，将操场变成了一片沙海。没人知道高登如何诓骗了工头和保安，但所有人都记得他是怎样套上纸壳头盔，向所有孩子振臂一呼，跃向了那片沙海。在高登被拽进校长室前，全校孩子的狂欢持续了两个小时。
对此，当时的高登称：“课都逃了，在操场上傻站着空喊两句台词，就觉得够意思了吗？”
……
第十三件展品是哥伦比亚蓝盒子公司1082年产的一张游戏光盘。
高登先生的游玩习惯非常特别。这款游戏并不以难度著称，但高登先生坚持在每一关反复扫荡，直至将能搜集到的所有装备道具积攒到存放上限，再进入BOSS房间，以期凭借装备道具的绝对储备击败BOSS。可惜，当时的游戏光盘使用寿命极其有限。由于过度使用，光盘在高登先生抵达最后一关时彻底损坏。高登先生最终也没能通关游戏结局。
对此，高登先生称：“如果不能保证第一次见就把BOSS摁死，那我去见它的意义是什么？”
……
最后一件展品是一棵原产自萨尔贡的矮树。
该展品来源于一颗从木棍上摘下的嫩芽，在高登先生特研的“生长激励喇叭”和“营养光波灯泡”的作用下，已经迅速繁衍到了第五代。如今，“螺旋桨天堂”的每一棵行道树，都是当初那颗嫩芽的后代。另有一百株树苗正被送往莱茵生命的总部，高登先生希望这种能在焚风热土存活的顽强树木，成为第一种在星荚之外繁衍生息的植物。
该展品的原主人，是一位被高登先生描述为“自由得令人生厌”的探险家。据悉，高登先生曾坚定地拒绝了此人的同行邀请，不是因为高登先生不向往未见的远方，而是对他来说，一身轻松地去探索，毫无意义。
当时，高登先生如是说：“你带着那根发芽的木棍走到哪儿，它也就是根个性一点的拐杖。倒不如把那颗芽给我，下次你见到的，会是一片移动的森林。”
……

“很好，零五四，完美的讲解，你终于完全理解我的需求了。”
“那么，‘天空征服者’，这个展会什么时候举办呢？”
“不急，等我把整个哥伦比亚都从地壳上抠下来，用超级螺旋桨带着所有人一起征服天空……等到那时候再说。至于现在，你的任务是每天晚上念这段讲解词帮我入睡。”

text.en:
A normally stoic Rhodes Island medic broke down in tears when he saw Rhodes Island medicine on the shelf of a Columbian drugstore.
In just six months, Rhodes Island's Oripathy medicine made rapid inroads into the Columbian market, which had been secluded itself for more than a decade. There is a long way to go until prices drop to a level affordable by the average Infected, but no one can deny that it is a huge first step.
Gordon Tannen, Chief Inspector of the ATAO, has never shunned any opportunity to flaunt his well-deserved pride as chief architect of this development. Following the incarceration of Gustave, former head of the ATAO, and the subsequent changing of the guard at the agency, Gordon Tannen has strengthened his own position while intentionally shredding the relationships that a certain corporation built into the ATAO for the purpose of enacting stringent Oripathy drug laws, enabling its monopoly.
However, rather than emphasize the help he rendered to Rhodes Island, Gordon boasts more often about 'building great things together with the Doctor'. Operators not in the know might believe him to be one of the Babel-era veteran, an elite operator operating undercover, after hearing him boast for two hours straight.
In fact, his first encounter with the Doctor was in Tkaronto four years ago, in an ATAO detention cell. Gordon had been working the border checkpoints for three years, and his only job in Tkaronto was to bring meals to the prisoners in the cells. At the same time, the Doctor had turned themself in in order to get the the ATAO to crack down on Mama John's, which had set a trap for Rhodes Island.
The dealings between the two of them began when the Doctor noticed a few extra meatballs in the dinner that Gordon brought.

'ATAO has every means at its disposal, and ATAO never fails. It's like a portable Arts unit with ready-to-cast Arts installed. All you need to do is aim and shoot, and anyone can buy one of those at an outdoor equipment shop for the price of a few hundred certs.
'The president can use it. Maylander can use it. Capitalists can use it. So why not us?
'That was the most important lesson I learned from the Doctor spending three days behind bars. And all it took was a few meatballs.'
text.zh:
看到罗德岛的药物寻常地出现在哥伦比亚一家药店的货柜上时，一位平日不苟言笑的罗德岛医疗干员就那样蹲在药店里哭了起来。
半年之内，罗德岛研发的矿石病药物，迅速地打通了闭塞十余年的哥伦比亚市场。把价格压低到感染者能负担得起的程度还需要长久的挣扎，但没人会否认这是一个良好的开端。
促成这一切的那个人，管理局探员总管高登·谭农，从不掩饰自己的骄傲。随着前任局长古斯塔夫入狱，管理局内部经历了一场大换血，而高登·谭农在巩固自己位置的同时，也有意地搅碎了当年那家为达成垄断而将最严苛的矿石病药物法规推上议会的企业在管理局内布下的关系网。
只不过，比起强调自己对罗德岛的帮助，他更多夸耀的是自己“正在和博士一起创立伟业”。不明就里的干员听过他长达两个小时的自夸之后，常常会以为他是巴别塔时代的前辈，一位隐藏身份的精英干员。
但实际上，他与博士的第一次相遇，是在四年多前的提卡伦多，管理局的拘留室里。彼时，高登已经在边境哨所驻守了三年，而在提卡伦多等待他的工作，也只是给拘留室里的囚犯们端饭。彼时，博士为了借管理局之手制裁为罗德岛设下圈套的约翰老妈，主动带着一纸自首书走进了边关管理局的办公室。
两人的缘分，始于博士注意到自己的牢饭里多出了几颗肉丸。

“管理局有的是手段，管理局从不失手。管理局就像是封装了现成法术的便携施术单元，只要瞄准了就能一击致命。不过，只要花上几百金券，谁都能在野外用品店买到一支便携施术单元。
“既然大总统能用它，梅兰德能用它，想搞垄断的大老板们也能用它……我们为什么不行？
“这是博士在拘留室的那三天，教会我的最重要的东西。我呢，只是交了十几颗肉丸的学费罢了。”
